budget_unit: first full RNAfold score of a sequence, failures included, repeats free
why_this_mode: initial_candidates.csv matches RNAfold-only scores; references and both methods use that same mode. Phy_mark weights are unchanged.
crs: uniform parent among all accepted candidates, same mutation operator, no crossover, edits can stack
ga: existing selection and crossover, same mutation operator and per-round scoring quota
primary_metric: best score when the budget is exhausted, minus the shared start best
inference: paired difference of gains across the 20 formal seeds, percentile bootstrap 95 percent interval
length_check: within each seed, compare maximum scores at lengths observed for both methods
